title.english: A Pin in the Right Place

pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎoshàng , tǎ wéi xiān xuéhuì de shì bǎ zhuō jiǎoxià de suìshí sǎo gānjìng .
pairs.english: The next morning, Tavi’s first lesson was sweeping gravel out from under the table feet.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早上，塔维先学会的是把桌脚下的碎石扫干净。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu méiyǒu tì tā sǎo . tā zhàn zài yìpáng , kàn tā cóng mù zuò xià chōuchū yílì báishí , wèn háiyǒu méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Master Rui did not sweep for him. She stood aside, watched him draw a white pebble from under the wooden base, and asked if there were more.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅没有替他扫。她站在一旁，看他从木座下抽出一粒白石，问还有没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huàn dào lìngyìbiān mō guò , shǒubèi cā le yídào huī , cái shuō méiyǒu . shí yán jiāng qīngzǎi guà shàng yòu qǔ xià , zhuōmiàn búzài gēnzhe huàng .
pairs.english: Tavi checked the other side by touch, smearing dust over his hand, before saying no. Shiyan hung and removed the light load; the tabletop no longer rocked with it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维换到另一边摸过，手背擦了一道灰，才说没有。石延将轻载挂上又取下，桌面不再跟着晃。

pairs.target: xiāng lǐ de tiě duì réng shì yuánlái de , wánzhěng tǐjī , jiēchùmiàn hé kè cáo dōu hé guò , zhǐ dǎng de wèizhì yě chóngxīn liáng le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The iron pair in the crate was unchanged; whole volumes, contact patches and grooves had been checked, and the stop positions measured again.
pairs.hanzi: 箱里的铁对仍是原来的，完整体积、接触面和刻槽都核过，止挡的位置也重新量了一遍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ jīxiàn xiě dào biǎo shàng , tīngjiàn héàn yǒurén hǎn chuán dào le , xiǎnxiē táitóu , bǐjiān què xiān tíngzhù . tā bǎ zhè yìháng xiě wán , cái kàn xiàng wàibiān .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote the baselines on the sheet. Hearing someone call that the boats had arrived, he almost looked up, but stopped his pen first, finished the line, then looked outside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把基线写到表上，听见河岸有人喊船到了，险些抬头，笔尖却先停住。他把这一行写完，才看向外边。

pairs.target: liǎngtiáochuán kào zài yuè qín zuótiān zhǐ de dìfāng . yán dài yìbāo bāo wǎng shàng dì , dài jiǎo zhān zhe shuǐ , jiē dài de rén jiānshàng diàn zhe hòu bù .
pairs.english: Two boats lay where Yueqin had pointed yesterday. Salt bags were passed up one by one, their corners wet, the receivers’ shoulders padded with thick cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 两条船靠在月芹昨天指的地方。盐袋一包包往上递，袋角沾着水，接袋的人肩上垫着厚布。

pairs.target: méiyǒu mùliào héng zài lùkǒu , tāmen zhuǎnshēn hěnkuài , yuè qín zìjǐ zhàn zài dìèrjí shíjiē shàng , suàn zhe dài shù , hái bú wàng cháo pénglǐ wèn rèshuǐ liú zhe méiyǒu .
pairs.english: With no timber blocking the way, they turned quickly. Yueqin stood on the second stone step counting bags, still remembering to call into the shed about the reserved hot water.
pairs.hanzi: 没有木料横在路口，他们转身很快，月芹自己站在第二级石阶上，算着袋数，还不忘朝棚里问热水留着没有。

pairs.target: shí yán jǔqǐ xǐ wù tǒng gěi tā kàn , tā bǎibǎishǒu , xiàng bǎ yíjiàn zhōngyú búyòng zài guǎn de shì huī dào shēnhòu .
pairs.english: Shiyan showed her the washing bucket. She waved, as though brushing behind her something she finally no longer had to manage.
pairs.hanzi: 石延举起洗物桶给她看，她摆摆手，像把一件终于不用再管的事挥到身后。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò de kòujiàn yào zhuāng zài páng qú de xiǎo kuàngshàng , yònglái bǎ kě chāi de héngtiáo liúzài kuàngnèi . děng ní cǎo jī duō le , rén néng jiě xià héngtiáo qīnglǐ , búbì bǎ zhěnggè kuàng tái zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi’s clasps would fit the small side-channel frames, retaining removable crossbars. When silt and grass accumulated, people could release the bars for cleaning instead of lifting the entire frame away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维做的扣件要装在旁渠的小框上，用来把可拆的横条留在框内。等泥草积多了，人能解下横条清理，不必把整个框抬走。

pairs.target: mùkuàng hé kòujiàn xiān zài xīn táishàng zhuāng hǎo , bān dào qú biān gùdìng shì gōng duì hòumiàn de huó , jīntiān bùyóu tā pèng jiù zhá .
pairs.english: The wooden frames and clasps would first be assembled on the new platform; carrying them to the channel and fixing them was the crew’s later task. He would not touch the old sluice today.
pairs.hanzi: 木框和扣件先在新台上装好，搬到渠边固定是工队后面的活，今天不由他碰旧闸。

pairs.target: shí yán nálái dìyī zhī kòujiàn , lǐmiàn yǒu gēn xì cì . tā yòng dāo guādiào , yánbiān mō le yìquān , cái fàngjìn jiājù .
pairs.english: Shiyan brought the first clasp, which had a fine splinter inside. He scraped it with a knife, felt around the edge, then placed it in the fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 石延拿来第一只扣件，里面有根细刺。他用刀刮掉，沿边摸了一圈，才放进夹具。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài shúxī de wèizhì , hūrán juéde yǎnqián hé liànxí shì hěn xiàng , yòu dàochù dōu bú xiàng : dìshàng shīqì zhòng , héshuǐ zài bèihòu xiǎng , fēng yìlái , zhǐ jiùyào pǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi stood in his familiar position; it suddenly felt like the practice room and unlike it everywhere: damp ground, river sounds behind him, paper ready to fly in every gust.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在熟悉的位置，忽然觉得眼前和练习室很像，又到处都不像：地上湿气重，河水在背后响，风一来，纸就要跑。

pairs.target: tā ná shíkuài yā zhǐ , ruì shīfu què dìgěi tā yìzhī mù jiá . shíkuài fàng dé tài jìn , tuì shǒu shíhuì ài zhe . tǎ wéi jiá hǎo , zìjǐ kōngshǒu zǒuguò yíbiàn , yòu ràng shí yán shì .
pairs.english: He weighted the paper with a stone, but Master Rui handed him a wooden clip. The stone was too close and would obstruct his withdrawing hand. Tavi clipped the paper, rehearsed empty-handed, then had Shiyan try.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿石块压纸，芮师傅却递给他一只木夹。石块放得太近，退手时会碍着。塔维夹好，自己空手走过一遍，又让石延试。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng huì shuō wěnzhù hé sòng xiāo , jīntiān shuō chūlái , réng pà zìjǐ de shēngyīn bèi ànshàng de hǎnshēng gàidiào . ruì shīfu ràng tā děng yì chuánhuò xièwán , zài lái .
pairs.english: He knew the ‘stable’ and ‘insert’ calls, but today still feared his voice would be drowned by the shouting on the bank. Master Rui told him to wait until a boat was unloaded before trying.
pairs.hanzi:
他已经会说稳住和送销，今天说出来，仍怕自己的声音被岸上的喊声盖掉。
芮师傅让他等一船货卸完，再来。

pairs.target: nà yìxiǎo duàn děngdài , jìng bǐ tiēzhe tiěpiàn gèng nánáo . tā kàn yán dài , kàn shuǐliú , kàn shí yán bǎ xiāozǐ ná qǐ yòu fàngxià , què méiyǒu jiāng liǎngzhīshǒu xiān dā dào jiēchùmiàn shàng .
pairs.english: That short wait felt harder than touching the iron. He watched salt bags, water and Shiyan lifting and lowering the pin, but did not rest his hands on the contact patches early.
pairs.hanzi: 那一小段等待，竟比贴着铁片更难熬。他看盐袋，看水流，看石延把销子拿起又放下，却没有将两只手先搭到接触面上。

pairs.target: děng yuè qín nàbiān de shēngyīn sànkāi , ruì shīfu cái diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Only after the noise around Yueqin subsided did Master Rui nod.
pairs.hanzi: 等月芹那边的声音散开，芮师傅才点头。

pairs.target: liǎngcè de huíyìng zài zhǎng xià jiē qǐlái . tā fàngmàn hūxī , tīngjiàn dúshù xiānghé , shuō wěnzhù . shí yán kànzhe tā de shǒu , méiyǒu dòng . " sòng xiāo . "
pairs.english: The responses joined beneath his palms. He slowed his breathing, heard the readings agree and called ‘stable.’ Shiyan watched his hands without moving. “Insert.”
pairs.hanzi:
两侧的回应在掌下接起来。他放慢呼吸，听见读数相合，说稳住。石延看着他的手，没有动。
“送销。”

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu tái kāi , dài jiǎn de shǒu cóng cèmiàn shēn lái . xiāozǐ zài dìyīshēng bǎi xiǎng qián luòxià , pèng hé de shēngyīn hěn qīng , jīhū bèi hé shēng chīdiào , tǎ wéi què kànjiàn liúzhì tóu yǐjīng jiùwèi , lìjí zhòng chù , qǔxiāo .
pairs.english: Both hands lifted, and the callused hand reached from the side. The pin fell before the first pendulum click, its soft seating sound almost swallowed by the river; Tavi saw the retaining head was seated and immediately recontacted and cancelled.
pairs.hanzi: 双手抬开，带茧的手从侧面伸来。销子在第一声摆响前落下，碰合的声音很轻，几乎被河声吃掉，塔维却看见留置头已经就位，立即重触、取消。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu hé huí dú , yòu xièzài jiǎnchá , kòujiàn cóng jiājù lǐ ná chūlái , réng kòu dé wěn .
pairs.english: Master Rui verified the return readings, unloaded and checked; removed from the fixture, the clasp still held firmly.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅核回读，又卸载检查，扣件从夹具里拿出来，仍扣得稳。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí hǎn hǎo . shí yán jiāng tā fàngjìn pángbiān de mùpán , jiēzhe náxià yìzhī .
pairs.english: Nobody cheered. Shiyan put it in the wooden tray beside him and reached for the next one.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁喊好。石延将它放进旁边的木盘，接着拿下一只。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu què bǎ pánzi wǎng wài yì yí , jiào tǎ wéi xiān lí zhuō , hēshuǐ , shèngxià jǐzhī kěyǐ yòng luó jiá zhuāng , búbì ràng yígè xīn zhùshǒu bǎ bàntiān dōu chēng zài yǎnjīng shàng .
pairs.english: But Master Rui moved the tray away and sent Tavi from the table to drink. The remaining pieces could be fitted with a screw clamp; a new assistant need not carry half a day’s work on his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅却把盘子往外一移，叫塔维先离桌，喝水，剩下几只可以用螺夹装，不必让一个新助手把半天都撑在眼睛上。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yǒudiǎn shīluò . zǒu dào péngwài , huítóu kàn shí yán nǐng luó jiá , cái fāxiàn nà shuāngshǒu yě yào tíngxiàlái shuǎi yi shuǎi . zhǐshì tā yǐqián kàn biérén gān shú le , zǒng juéde yònglì hǎoxiàng búyòng huā shénme .
pairs.english: He felt a little let down at first. Outside the shed, he looked back at Shiyan tightening the clamp and saw that those hands too needed to stop and shake. Watching experienced people before, he had always thought effort cost them almost nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来有点失落。走到棚外，回头看石延拧螺夹，才发现那双手也要停下来甩一甩。只是他以前看别人干熟了，总觉得用力好像不用花什么。

pairs.target: wǔfàn duānshànglái , yán guǒrán zhòng . shí yán chī dìyīkǒu biàn kàn xiàng tā , tǎ wéi rěn zhe méi xiào , yuè qín zài pángbiān shuō jīntiān búshì zìjǐ dāngbān , shuí ài kuā jiù qù zào hòu kuā .
pairs.english: Lunch arrived, and the salt was indeed heavy. Shiyan looked at him after the first bite; Tavi held back a laugh. Yueqin said she was not cooking today, so anyone wanting to give praise should go behind the stove.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭端上来，盐果然重。石延吃第一口便看向他，塔维忍着没笑，月芹在旁边说今天不是自己当班，谁爱夸就去灶后夸。

pairs.target: fànhòu , nài lěi cóng jiù péng nà tóu huílái , yīxiù shàng zhān zhe huī . tā jiāng liǎngpiàn fēnbié xuánguà de xiǎo tiě yàng jiāogěi liúshǒu de rén , jiào rén zhào yuánlái de qīngzǎi jì dúshù , bùxǔ jiāng tāmen nálái còu zhuāngpèi de pèiduì .
pairs.english: After lunch, Nerai returned from the old shed, dust on her sleeves. She gave the caretaker two separately suspended small iron samples, to record under their original light loads, never to be used as an assembly pair.
pairs.hanzi: 饭后，奈蕾从旧棚那头回来，衣袖上沾着灰。她将两片分别悬挂的小铁样交给留守的人，叫人照原来的轻载记读数，不许将它们拿来凑装配的配对。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhī zài pángbiān tīng , méiyǒu qù pèng . tā wèn tā jīntiān zuò le shénme . tā bǎ mùpán lǐ nà zhī kòujiàn zhǐ gěi tā kàn , chàdiǎn shēnshǒu ná , yòu xiǎngdào gāng chīwánfàn , xiān cājìng shǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi only listened without touching. She asked what he had done today. He pointed out the clasp in the tray, nearly picked it up, then remembered he had just eaten and wiped his hands first.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维只在旁边听，没有去碰。
她问他今天做了什么。他把木盘里那只扣件指给她看，差点伸手拿，又想到刚吃完饭，先擦净手。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le kàn , shuō tā zǒngsuàn búyòng zài dài zài liànxí zhuōshàng le .
pairs.english: Nerai looked and said it would finally no longer have to stay on a practice table.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了看，说它总算不用再待在练习桌上了。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tā bāng shí yányòng luó jiá zhuāngwán yúxià de jǐzhī , zuò de shì dìngwèi hé dì xiāo , méiyǒu zài kāi jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: At dusk he helped Shiyan finish the rest with the screw clamp, positioning pieces and passing pins, without starting another exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他帮石延用螺夹装完余下的几只，做的是定位和递销，没有再开交换。

pairs.target: mùpán jiànjiàn mǎn le , měi yìzhī dōu pǔtōng dé hěn , hùn dào yìqǐ , tā yǐjīng rènbùchū zǎoshàng nà zhǐshì nǎgè .
pairs.english: The wooden tray gradually filled. Every clasp looked utterly ordinary, and once mixed together he could no longer tell which was the morning’s.
pairs.hanzi: 木盘渐渐满了，每一只都普通得很，混到一起，他已经认不出早上那只是哪个。

pairs.target: tā ná běnzi jì wǎnfàn , xiě dào yíbàn , yòu fān huí qián yè , bǎ jīntiān nà yìlán cóng " zuò le yígè kòujiàn " gǎichéng " tóng shí yán zhuāng hǎo yìpán ".
pairs.english: Writing dinner notes, he stopped halfway and turned back, changing today’s entry from “made a clasp” to “assembled a trayful with Shiyan.”
pairs.hanzi: 他拿本子记晚饭，写到一半，又翻回前页，把今天那一栏从“做了一个扣件”改成“同石延装好一盘”。
